title: JAX/XLA Shardy (MLIR) vs. GSPMD Partitioner, Hierarchical Device Mesh & ICI-vs-DCN Parallelism Benchmark

tiers.name: Tier 1: Misaligned Mesh (Stretching TP/FSDP Across Inter-Slice DCN Instead of ICI)
tiers.verdict: Anti-Pattern: Per-layer TP/FSDP AllGather over DCN stalls MXUs 68.5% of every step (15.8% MFU)

tiers.name: Tier 2: 1D Flat FSDP-Only Mesh (No 2D/3D ICI Axis Decomposition for TP/EP)
tiers.verdict: 512-hop 1D FSDP ring underutilizes orthogonal 3D Torus axes & causes activation OOMs

tiers.name: Tier 3: Legacy HLO GSPMD Partitioner on Hybrid MoE (Unresolved Branch Reshard Conflicts)
tiers.verdict: GSPMD inserts 38GB/step of redundant All-to-All/AllGather reshards between MoE & Attention

tiers.name: Tier 4: XLA Shardy (MLIR) Priority Propagation + Hierarchical ICI/DCN Mesh + shard_map
tiers.verdict: Recommended: 59.6% MFU (+11.4 pts vs GSPMD), 0.0GB redundant reshards & -62.2% TCO
